name: poe-na-tela
description: Põe na Tela! — Plataforma de streaming de jogos em 30 FPS para amigos

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,DESKTOP" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "cd desktop && npm run dev"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:client && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('client/dist', 'desktop/client-dist', { recursive: true })" && cd desktop && npm run build
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:client && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('client/dist', 'desktop/client-dist', { recursive: true })" && cd desktop && npm run dist
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
